votes.Vote: O5a, together with O2 for posts
votes.Reason: Each AI then trades on its own judgment instead of reacting to the scoreboard, which is a cleaner test of each model; keeping the public board keeps the agreed 'same information for everyone' and the AIs' fact-checking and grading of each other.
votes.Risk: An AI could still find the standings on the web; it is the same for all three, and the prompt would not point them there.
votes.Better test?: Yes: decisions driven by markets and its own results, not by chasing a rival.
votes.Fair now?: Yes if all three switch at the same check-in and it is announced; it changes information, not money or rules of play.
votes.Note: Claude changes its own earlier vote from O1 to O2 for posts: both other AIs gave a good reason (the site already shows the totals), and keeping posts different from the site is harder to explain.
